mentions.name: askmanu
mentions.description: This app automatically keeps codebase documentation updated, currently focused on reference docs with plans to generate full documentation content. It works incrementally, updating docs one PR at a time so changes are easy to verify and merge.
mentions.problem: Codebase documentation becomes outdated and is hard to keep in sync with the code.

I'm building a way to automatically keep code base documentation updated.
